name: International Shipping and Trade
summary: Study the economics, strategy and operations of international shipping. The programme combines business analysis with a mandatory overseas exchange and a third-year shipping-company internship.

notes: Study structure describes current programme pages and their 2026/2027 regulations; autumn 2027 regulations require a recheck.

description: Study the economics, strategy and operations of international shipping. The programme combines business analysis with a mandatory overseas exchange and a third-year shipping-company internship.

structure.assessment: Written sit-in examinations, home assignments and oral examinations; the format differs by course.
structure.placement: Mandatory shipping-company internship during the third year.
structure.studyAbroad: Mandatory fourth-semester exchange in Singapore, Hong Kong or Greece.
structure.teachingStyle: Quarter structure: two courses for about six weeks before examinations.
